assistant.keys-stored-locally: Account keys are stored securely on your machine and never sent to our servers.
assistant.model-saved-per-workspace: Model settings are saved per workspace and apply to all new chats.

chat.ask-workspace-on-title: Ask my workspace is ON, every message searches your files first
chat.ask-workspace-off-title: Ask my workspace is OFF, click to have every message search your files
chat.trial-ended-help: Activate a license in Settings, License to keep chatting with AI. Your existing files stay accessible. Only AI calls and workflows are paused.
chat.model-not-ready-refuse: Your private search engine is still downloading, so I can't search your workspace yet and won't answer from your client. Watch the setup banner for progress, or turn off "Ask my workspace" to send this without workspace grounding.
chat.retrieval-failed-refuse: I couldn't search your workspace just now, so I won't answer from your client. {{reason}} You can turn off "Ask my workspace" to send this without workspace grounding.
chat.workspace-empty-refuse: I searched your workspace and found nothing relevant to that, so I won't answer from your client. Try rephrasing, or turn off "Ask my workspace" to get a general answer.

privilege-explainer.title: What does privilege exclusion do?
privilege-explainer.body: Sources tagged privileged are filtered out of workspace retrieval itself, before anything reaches the AI. It is enforced in the search engine, not just a label.
privilege-explainer.demo: See it work on my own files
privilege-explainer.no-question: Type a question in the chat box first, then run this check.
privilege-explainer.withheld: Privilege exclusion is withholding {{count}} source(s) from this question right now. Top withheld source: {{name}}.
privilege-explainer.none-withheld: No privileged sources matched this question, so nothing was withheld.
privilege-explainer.desktop-only: This live check runs in the desktop app.

title.create-file: The AI wants to create a file
title.overwrite-file: The AI wants to change a file
title.create-folder: The AI wants to create a folder
title.move-file: The AI wants to move a file
title.delete-file: The AI wants to delete a file

write-approval.description: Review the change below. Nothing happens until you approve.
write-approval.move-overwrite-warning: This replaces an existing file at the destination.
write-approval.delete-trash-note: The file will be moved to Trash, so you can recover it.
write-approval.binary-note: This is a non-text file, so there's no preview here. Approve to let the AI change it.

batch-review.title: Review what the AI changed
batch-review.description: The AI applied these changes during this turn. Keep them all, or undo any you don't want.
batch-review.binary-note: This is a non-text file, so there's no preview.
batch-review.not-undoable: This change can't be undone automatically.
batch-review.unsafe-partial: Some of these changes build on each other, so undoing only part of them could lose work. Select the related later changes too, or choose Keep all changes.

compression.title: This conversation is getting long
compression.body: This message would go over the AI's memory limit for this chat. Shortening the earlier conversation lets it through. Nothing is deleted from your files, only this chat's history is trimmed.

pdf-preview.encrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Remove the password and re-attach.
pdf-preview.scanned: This PDF appears to be a scanned image with no text layer. Extracted text may be empty.
pdf-preview.send-as-native: Send as native PDF instead (lets the AI read the image)

search.tip-quick-open: to quickly open any file by name
search.tip-formats: Text files, docx, xlsx, pptx, RTF are all indexed
search.tip-snippet: Click a result to open the file with a match snippet

memory.ocr-progress: Reading scanned pages with local OCR: page {{page}} of {{total}}. Nothing leaves your machine.
memory.pdf-progress: Indexing PDFs: {{processed}} / {{total}}. Nothing leaves your machine.

citation.scanned-low-title: This passage was read from a scanned page by local OCR with low confidence. Open the source and verify before relying on it.

model-download.title: Setting up your private AI (1 of 2: search)
model-download.body: {{productName}} is downloading the part that searches your files (about 465 MB), one time. You can keep working. Search and AI answers from your files switch on when it finishes.
model-download.stalled: The download looks stuck. Restarting {{productName}} resumes it where it stopped.
model-download.error-title: The search engine download was interrupted
model-download.error-body: Nothing is lost. The download resumes where it stopped.

local-ai-download.title: Setting up your private AI (2 of 2: the AI that writes answers)
local-ai-download.body: {{productName}} is downloading the part that writes answers (about 2.4 GB), one time. You can keep working. It runs fully offline once it's ready.
local-ai-download.stalled: The download looks stuck. Restarting {{productName}} resumes it where it stopped.
local-ai-download.error-body: Nothing is lost. The download resumes where it stopped.

book.no-facts: No client summaries are built yet. Open a client and build their Client Map first.
book.no-matches: No clients in your book match that question.
book.summaries-note-title: Answered from saved Client Maps. Documents were not searched across clients.

demo-intro.body: Answers are cited to these files. Click a citation to open the source.

empty.sample-title: Try one of these sample questions.

file-access.prompt-body: It can search and read files. File text may go to {{provider}}. Any edit still asks first.
file-access.reconfirm: This chat now covers {{scopeLabel}}, so it needs your OK again.
file-access.details: Until you allow it, the AI only uses what you type and files you open or attach yourself.
file-access.granted: File access on. Edits still ask first.

sources.title: Sources
sources.empty-hint: No file sources for this answer.
sources.footer-note: No file sources for this answer.
sources.provenance-title: {{productName}} reads the files you already have. This is not a live connection.
sources.provenance-file: Reads the file you already have
sources.provenance-file-date: Reads the file you already have · {{date}}
sources.provenance-stale-title: This file may be out of date. Add a newer file when you have one.

status.verified-title: The stored source was checked and contains this exact quote.
status.checking-title: Checking this quote against the stored source.
status.found-title: This source was found. The automatic check could not confirm the exact quote.

answer-scope.title: Answer settings
answer-scope.helper: Control sources and file access for this chat.
answer-scope.files-only-title: Answer only from your files, cited, with no general knowledge or drafts.

answer-blocks.draft-note: Draft for you to review before sending. Nothing is sent automatically.
answer-blocks.cited-attestation: Cited from your files. Open any number to check.
answer-blocks.nothing-found-note: No file match. General guidance is marked.

turn.decline-note-client: Nothing found in your files. Try a question about this client.
turn.decline-note-all: Nothing found in your files. Try a question about your clients.
turn.still-importing-decline: Still importing. Try again when it finishes.
turn.uncited-warning: Not cited from your files. Verify this before relying on it.
turn.stale-plan-warning: Uses old plan exports: {{exports}}. Re-export to refresh.
turn.importing-banner: Importing files and email. Answers may be incomplete.

message-scope.matter-title: This answer was confined to the active {{entity}}. Other clients' data was not searched.

sample-bridge.body: Sample data. Add your first {{entity}} to search your files.

cost-dashboard.provider-note: Costs are billed directly by {{provider}}, not by {{productName}}.

answer-dates.title: Dates in the cited records
answer-dates.record-copy-flagged: Matching record copies have different timestamps.
answer-dates.review-record-copies: Check the cited copies before relying on either date.
